## About this blog:

Hello, my name is Hayatt Slimani! I graduated with my Associates of Science in Social Sciences from Tidewater Community College in the spring of 2025. Currently, I am a Junior at George Washington University majoring in Data Science with a concentration in geospatial analysis. I enjoy going to the beach, swimming, traveling, baking, and reading. My favorite current read is Be Water My Friend by Shannon Lee. I hope you enjoy checking out my blog :)
